# 74279 - Quadruple S-R latches

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74279.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74279.json)

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 41 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4,7,9,13 | Q = latch state | Each output is its latch's stored bit (two cross-coupled NAND gates). For latches 1 and 3, S' means both S' inputs: S'=H when both are high, S'=L when one or both are low. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: levels on S' and R' (no clock)

- S'=H, R'=H: Q = Q0 (hold)
- S'=L, R'=H: Q = H
- S'=H, R'=L: Q = L
- S'=L, R'=L: Q = H, pseudo-stable: it may not persist when S' and R' return to high
- Latches 1 and 3: S' is low when either S1' or S2' is low

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | SN74279: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-70 C. Diode-clamped inputs, totem-pole outputs. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S' | Q | PLH | 12 | 22 |
| S' | Q | PHL | 9 | 15 |
| R' | Q | PHL | 15 | 27 |

## Not known

- The datasheet lists tPHL from S' (9/15 ns) without saying which condition makes S' drive Q low; recorded as printed.
- No minimum propagation delays printed.
